messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@stellarpay.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.g@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal sprint intake + QBR date options

Hi Rachel / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Per our conversation, I want to kick off the renewal + expansion sprint so we have a clean playbook and QBR on the calendar before the end of the quarter. High-level objectives:

- Finalize term change from 12 -> 24 months (customer-requested).
- Scope a 50% committed capacity uplift with 2x burst pool for marketing spikes.
- Lock pricing/discount cadence and procurement timeline so Ops can provision Dedicated capacity by July.

Proposed timeline (three-week sprint):
1) Week 1 (May 6–12): intake + requirements, procurement contact, finalize uplift numbers. Responsible: StellarPay (usage confirmation), Redwood (cost/throughput proposal).
2) Week 2 (May 13–19): contract redline pass + internal review. Responsible: Redwood legal (Markus), StellarPay procurement.
3) Week 3 (May 20–26): final sign, capacity reservation + onboarding runbook. Responsible: Redwood CS (Monica) + Ops.

QBR — suggested windows (pick one):
- Option A: Tue, May 16, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed, May 17, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Option C: Thu, May 18, 09:00–10:00 PT

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Rachel / Priya: confirm which QBR option works and share procurement contact (email) by EOD Monday (May 8).
- StellarPay: share last 90-day token usage CSV and expected growth targets (attachment stub is sample usage snapshot).
- Redwood (Markus): prepare initial term amendment redline (draft due May 12).
- Redwood (Monica): draft QBR agenda and invite once date confirmed.

Attachments: Renewal_Playbook_v2.pdf (playbook draft), Usage_Snapshot_Apr2028.csv (sample export).

If that timeline looks tight, tell us which items you want to stretch. Otherwise we'll treat May 6 as the sprint start and begin internal prep.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Ben — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A couple notes from our side:

- We can confirm the uplift numbers (50% committed, 2x burst) but need to circulate that to our product leads for a quick check. Expect confirmation by Monday morning.
- Procurement contact: procurement@stellarpay.com (cc'd here as a group alias). If you need a named contact, add me and I'll loop in Priya.
- For the QBR, Option B (Wed, May 17, 14:00–15:00 PT) is best for our execs.

Quick ask — can you include an explicit list of SLA targets + fallback model options in the redline so our legal can review operational guarantees? Also please include the estimate for monthly unit cost after the uplift (ballpark numbers fine).
